## 📋 Module Overview

This module establishes core **Programming Fundamentals** applicable across languages, with a focus on logical thinking and problem decomposition.

## 📚 Course Structure

::: {.callout-note}
## Module Contents
- **Chapter 1** — Introduction to Programming & Computational Thinking
- **Chapter 2** — Variables, Data Types, and Operators
- **Chapter 3** — Control Flow: Conditionals and Loops
- **Chapter 4** — Functions & Modular Programming
- **Chapter 5** — Recursion
- **Chapter 6** — Introduction to Complexity (Big-O)
:::
